what: Sections stacked in one panel (6 photo : 4 text) switch every 5 seconds with a 1s crossfade (Swiper fade). The progress bar below fills straight from the left over 5s. When the switch begins, it shrinks to the right end over .67s (transition length ÷ 1.5) ease-in-out, then starts filling again from 0 once the new section is fully lit. The number changes to the current section. After the switch, the previous section’s text waits at -15px and the next section’s text waits at +15px with a .5s delay, so at the next fade they slide in sideways (.35s)

options.delay: Time spent on one slide (ms), default 5000 — the bar fills over this length too
options.speed: Crossfade length (ms), default 1000 — bar drop-out is this ÷ 1.5
options.lag: Delay (ms) before moving the next section text to the standby spot, default 500
options.--fx-nudge · --fx-dur · --fx-ease: Text wait distance, push length and curve (via style), defaults 15px · .35s · cubic-bezier(.27,.83,.64,1)
options.--fx-fill · --fx-track: Bar color · bar frame color (via style), default --kf-ink · --kf-bg
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper panel (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — not needed if data-fx is put directly on the panel
options.[data-fx-part=bar] · [data-fx-part=fill]: Progress bar frame and filling bar (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text block sliding in sideways within the section (optional)
